crossRefs.note: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.
Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?
He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

translations.web: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
translations.bsb: Do you understand how the clouds float, those wonders of Him who is perfect in knowledge?
translations.kjv: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
translations.asv: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, The wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?
